card.name: Words like promptly and any before symptoms
card.fires_on: The words "promptly" and "any" in label instructions that tell patients or clinicians to report, evaluate or watch for symptoms. They come right before words such as report, evaluate, new, or symptoms.

modes.label: promptly before an action
modes.description: "promptly" placed after an instruction verb, ahead of report, evaluate or seek.
modes.example: Instruct patients to<< promptly>> report any unexplained muscle pain, tend

modes.label: any before a symptom or patient
modes.description: "any" opening a phrase about a patient or symptom that needs attention.
modes.example: Consider the diagnosis of PML in<< any>> patient presenting with new-onset neurologic

card.plain: It marks the word that tells someone to act quickly or watch for any symptom in warning instructions.
